path.description: Repo-relative path of the pinned copy, if committed.

provenance.description: PRD: record solver revision, units, coverage, runtime and verification outcome with each result.

kind.description: archive = read from a pinned upstream file; derived = computed by labyrinth_main from archives; prd-reported = number stated in PRD.md with no underlying data in this repo; live/rehearsal = produced by a GX worker; model = output of an illustrative reduced model whose parameters were chosen for illustration, not fitted to measurements - not a simulation of W7-X and not verified against one (D-027).

runtime.description: Wall-clock runtime of the producing run, or 'unknown'.

window.description: [lo, hi] with lo <= hi. JSON Schema cannot compare the two items, so producers enforce the order.

fixtureCheck.description: A number (or range) claimed in PRD.md (or, with claimSource "task", in the feature's tasks/<NN>/TASK.md) compared against the value this repo recomputes (decision D-023).

claimed.description: The single value the claim's source prints (PRD.md unless claimSource says otherwise). null exactly when that source prints a range instead (see claimedRange); never a value the source did not print.

claimSource.description: Where claimed / claimedRange is printed. Absent means "prd" (PRD.md). "task" = only the feature's tasks/<NN>/TASK.md prints it (the PRD implies it at most): consumers label it as a TASK.md figure, never as a PRD figure.

claimedRange.description: [lo, hi] with lo <= hi when the source prints a range (producers enforce the order: JSON Schema cannot compare items). Then claimed is null and matches means lo <= computed <= hi (no rounding).

matches.description: null when it cannot be recomputed from data in this repo.

basis.description: arithmetic = the check only re-does arithmetic on PRD-reported inputs (no data in this repo); absent means data.
